applies_to: Public semantic documents collections and evidence

annotation_requirements: Grid/reading order; wrapping; navigation disclosure; sticky obstruction; data/list alternative; print width when applicable
exception_rule: None may be omitted; a visually identical intermediate viewport may use an annotation linked to both bounding frames

applies_to: AI handoff booking contact and transactional panels
minimum_evidence: Complete FRAME at VP-320 VP-LANDSCAPE and VP-DESKTOP; interaction annotations and error-summary/focus evidence at all values
annotation_requirements: Field order; action stacking; keyboard visibility; error summary; local-time strings; safe-area and virtual-keyboard implications

applies_to: World stream onboarding HUD panels thresholds and Quick Access recovery

applies_to: Staff authentication queues work detail publication review release and audit
minimum_evidence: FRAME at VP-320 VP-TABLET VP-DESKTOP and VP-ZOOM-400; table-to-list/detail behavior and long-ID stress
annotation_requirements: Queue/detail priority; version/checksum wrapping; bulk density without hidden actions; permission/status visibility; focus order

applies_to: Public semantic routes and evidence
minimum_evidence: Standard frames plus focused mode evidence; forced-colors/grayscale/font/asset/print captures; keyboard path and screen-reader semantic annotation
annotation_requirements: Evidence-label redundancy; contrast; reading order; focus; missing asset alternative; no motion/color/material/image-only meaning

applies_to: AI handoff booking contact navigation and dialogs
minimum_evidence: Standard and critical state frames; forced-color and font/asset captures; keyboard prototype; screen-reader specification; printable summary where applicable
annotation_requirements: No focus theft/trap; accessible names/status; disabled versus pending; input purpose; redundant entry; safe reauthentication
exception_rule: Print interaction controls may be omitted only when a truthful printable status/summary and non-print action route are specified

applies_to: World stream and HUD
minimum_evidence: Standard HUD/onboarding frames; stable reduced/low-power states; paired Quick Access; forced-colors DOM overlay; asset failure; keyboard and semantics
annotation_requirements: No canvas-only label/action; audio off; persistent Exit/Book/Quick Access; location announcement; no essential camera travel
exception_rule: MODE-PRINT is not applicable to the live World canvas; canonical semantic route print evidence remains required through MP-PUBLIC. Stream-axis precedence, stated so no producer has to infer it: where this mode axis excludes a mode that a stream in presence(record) requires, the stream axis prevails and the frame is drawn. The governing instance is MODE-PRINT, excluded from the live World canvas and required by DS-S-SEMANTIC: both are true, and the frame is drawn in S-SEMANTIC

applies_to: Staff and publication surfaces

exception_rule: MODE-SEMANTIC-SHELL is inherently satisfied because staff UI cannot depend on WebGL; record as annotation rather than a separate frame

applies_to: Every public interactive World Quick Access and staff reference template route flow profile and production batch
required_values: Current latest two stable release families of Chrome Edge Firefox and Safari selected by dated QA; Safari on iOS 16.4 is the minimum legacy floor; semantic Quick Access for clients below that floor or otherwise unsupported
minimum_evidence: Dated later QA records the exact current stable versions; Safari/iOS 16.4 mobile layout input virtual-keyboard and safe-area evidence; representative current evergreen evidence; below-floor and otherwise-unsupported recovery evidence proves semantic Quick Access without WebGL
annotation_requirements: Record browser engine platform input method viewport safe-area behavior support disposition and paired semantic destination; never infer exact current versions at this documentation freeze
exception_rule: No browser-specific omission may remove essential content or action; a client outside the profile must recover through semantic Quick Access

applies_to: A user time limit assigned to the removable-or-adjustable branch of WCAG 2.2 SC 2.2.1
required_values: The user can turn off the time limit before encountering it or adjust it before start over the criterion-supported range
minimum_evidence: Branch selection shown in the affected reference; control is keyboard and screen-reader operable; permitted data and last authoritative state survive; accessible reauthentication is shown if a protected session is affected; exact product duration remains gated
annotation_requirements: Identify affected route flow template profile and batch; distinguish a user time limit from provider latency or system response timeout
exception_rule: If neither removal nor pre-start adjustment is supported assign TL-WARN-EXTEND or document a criterion-supported TL-EXCEPTION before production

applies_to: A user time limit assigned to the warning-and-extension branch of WCAG 2.2 SC 2.2.1
required_values: Warn at least 20 seconds before expiry and provide a simple extension of at least ten times the default limit
minimum_evidence: Branch selection shown in the affected reference; warning status and extension control are keyboard and screen-reader operable; permitted data and last authoritative state survive expiry; accessible reauthentication returns to preserved context; exact product duration remains gated
annotation_requirements: Identify affected route flow template profile and batch; record authoritative state and extension behavior; do not treat provider latency or system response timeout as the user limit
exception_rule: A different treatment requires TL-REMOVABLE-ADJUSTABLE or a criterion-supported TL-EXCEPTION accepted through the standards-exception human gate

applies_to: Only a documented criterion-supported exception to WCAG 2.2 SC 2.2.1
required_values: The exception record identifies the applicable criterion language affected complete process rationale fallback preservation behavior and independent accessibility-review acceptance
minimum_evidence: Exception record plus affected reference evidence; permitted data and last authoritative state preservation where allowed; accessible reauthentication where applicable; exact product duration remains gated
annotation_requirements: Name the exact criterion-supported exception and affected route flow template profile and batch; standards target changes remain a human gate
exception_rule: Not assignable by this package without a separately reviewed exception record; no current package record selects this branch

applies_to: A reference with no user time limit in the accepted definition
required_values: No user time limit is introduced; provider latency loading retry cooldown and system response timeout are documented separately and cannot silently become a user time limit
minimum_evidence: Explicit not-applicable mapping; if later production introduces a user limit it must select TL-REMOVABLE-ADJUSTABLE TL-WARN-EXTEND or a criterion-supported TL-EXCEPTION before review
annotation_requirements: State why no user time limit applies and preserve the gate against later implicit limits
exception_rule: Any introduced limit invalidates this mapping until an allowed branch and evidence are assigned

applies_to: Full-richness World stream on clients that pass the WebGL probe and report the highest device tier
minimum_evidence: Contrast, target size and focus order measured against this stream's own rendering and never inherited from another stream; the delivery stream control shown reporting S-HIGH as current with its accessible name legible in the annotation; MODE-STANDARD, MODE-REDUCED-MOTION, MODE-KEYBOARD and MODE-SCREEN-READER captures; no degradation vocabulary in any annotation. Axis intersection is explicit and counted once: where a frame required here would also satisfy another profile it is drawn once and annotated with both profile IDs, so no frame is counted twice and no obligation is discharged by an aggregate frame that names no stream. World-content obligations are not stated here; under N-03 they attach to TPL-WORLD-SHELL and TPL-WORLD-HUD
annotation_requirements: Contrast target size and focus order are each measured against this stream's own rendering and never inherited from another stream; the delivery stream control is annotated with its current value and its accessible name; no annotation may use degradation vocabulary
exception_rule: A stream may be marked not applicable only where the WebGL probe makes it unreachable for every client; S-SEMANTIC may never be marked not applicable

applies_to: Reduced-shadow medium-texture World stream on the middle device tier
minimum_evidence: Contrast, target size and focus order measured against this stream's own rendering and never inherited from another stream; the delivery stream control shown reporting S-MEDIUM as current with its accessible name legible in the annotation; MODE-STANDARD, MODE-KEYBOARD and MODE-SCREEN-READER captures; no degradation vocabulary in any annotation. Axis intersection is explicit and counted once. World-content obligations are not stated here; under N-03 they attach to TPL-WORLD-SHELL and TPL-WORLD-HUD
annotation_requirements: Contrast target size and focus order are each measured against this stream's own rendering and never inherited from another stream; the delivery stream control is annotated with its current value and its accessible name; no annotation may use degradation vocabulary
exception_rule: A stream may be marked not applicable only where the WebGL probe makes it unreachable for every client; S-SEMANTIC may never be marked not applicable

applies_to: Unshadowed low-texture World stream; the unsignalled default and the highest-traffic first-paint stream
minimum_evidence: Designed first, not last. Contrast, target size and focus order measured against this stream's own rendering and never inherited from another stream; the delivery stream control shown reporting S-LOW as current with its accessible name legible in the annotation; MODE-LOW-POWER, MODE-KEYBOARD and MODE-SCREEN-READER captures; no degradation vocabulary in any annotation. This stream reduces fidelity only and removes no destination. Axis intersection is explicit and counted once. World-content obligations are not stated here; under N-03 they attach to TPL-WORLD-SHELL and TPL-WORLD-HUD
annotation_requirements: Contrast target size and focus order are each measured against this stream's own rendering and never inherited from another stream; the delivery stream control is annotated with its current value and its accessible name; no annotation may use degradation vocabulary
exception_rule: A stream may be marked not applicable only where the WebGL probe makes it unreachable for every client; S-SEMANTIC may never be marked not applicable

applies_to: Peer stream for clients without a WebGL context; semantic navigation with static imagery
minimum_evidence: Every core journey completed end to end using only this stream; a named equivalent action for every route reachable in S-HIGH; contrast, target size and focus order measured against this stream's own rendering and never inherited from another stream; the delivery stream control shown reporting S-SEMANTIC as current, with its accessible name legible in the annotation, reachable without a canvas; MODE-FORCED-COLORS, MODE-PRINT, MODE-KEYBOARD and MODE-SCREEN-READER captures; keyboard path and screen-reader reading order; no degradation vocabulary in any annotation. Axis intersection is explicit and counted once. World-content obligations are not stated here; under N-03 they attach to TPL-WORLD-SHELL and TPL-WORLD-HUD
annotation_requirements: Contrast target size and focus order are each measured against this stream's own rendering and never inherited from another stream; the delivery stream control is annotated with its current value and its accessible name; no annotation may use degradation vocabulary
exception_rule: S-SEMANTIC may never be marked not applicable. MODE-PRINT applies here and is not covered by the MP-WORLD print exclusion, because S-SEMANTIC is the semantic shell and not the live World canvas. S-SEMANTIC is never drawn as STATE-WEBGL-UNSUPPORTED: that state belongs to the World shell losing a context it had, while S-SEMANTIC is a peer stream a client may be served from first paint, so it carries no failure heading no error styling and no language of escape recovery or fallback
